app.name: Cevherclient
app.tagline: Connect to the world where ore shines

login.title: Welcome
login.subtitle: Enter the player name you will use on the server.
login.loginHint: Sign in with your account. You won't be asked for a password in-game.
login.registerHint: Create your account for the server. You sign in from the launcher with this name and password; no password in-game.
login.usernameRule: 3–16 characters; letters, digits and underscores only.

java.title: Java
java.autoHint: The right Java is picked for each version automatically.

memory.title: Memory (RAM)
memory.hint: At least 2 GB is left free for the system.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.fitHint: In windowed mode, if the size is larger than your screen, the game window is shrunk to fit.

jvm.title: JVM arguments
jvm.hint: For advanced users. Separate with spaces.

store.empty: The store has no products right now.
store.notLinked: Your launcher account isn't linked to your website account yet. Sign out and sign back in with the same name and password to link it; if the name belongs to someone else on the website, contact an admin.
store.confirmHint: The amount is taken from your website balance and the item is delivered to your account.
store.insufficient: Your balance isn't enough for this item.
store.boughtMessage: {{name}} is being delivered to your account.

JAVA_NOT_FOUND.title: Java not found
JAVA_NOT_FOUND.message: This version needs Java {{version}}, but no suitable installation was found. Check the Java path in Settings or switch it to "Automatic".

NO_INTERNET.title: No internet connection
NO_INTERNET.message: The servers can't be reached. Check your connection and try again.

AUTH_FAILED.title: Sign-in failed
AUTH_FAILED.message: Could not sign in. Please try again.

reasons.invalidUsername: The username must be 3–16 characters and contain only letters, digits and underscores.
reasons.usernameTaken: This player name is already taken. Try another name or sign in.
reasons.weakPassword: The password must be at least 6 characters.
reasons.protectedName: This name belongs to a server admin; it can only be registered from the server machine.
reasons.tooManyAccounts: The account limit for this connection has been reached.
reasons.tooManyAttempts: Too many failed attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
reasons.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
reasons.serverUnreachable: Could not reach the account server. The game server may be offline.
reasons.serverError: The account server returned an error. Please notify the admins.

DOWNLOAD_FAILED.title: Download failed
DOWNLOAD_FAILED.message: Files could not be downloaded. You can restart the download.

reasons.noVersion: This mod has not been released for the server's Minecraft version (Fabric).

LAUNCH_FAILED.title: Couldn't start the game
LAUNCH_FAILED.message: Something went wrong while starting Minecraft.

SERVER_OFFLINE.title: Server offline
SERVER_OFFLINE.message: {{server}} isn't responding right now. Try again in a bit.

MODPACK_SYNC_FAILED.title: Mod sync failed
MODPACK_SYNC_FAILED.message: The server's modpack couldn't be updated. You can't join the server with missing mods.

STORE_FAILED.title: Store action failed
STORE_FAILED.message: The action couldn't be completed. Please try again.

reasons.notLinked: Your launcher account isn't linked to your website account. Sign out and sign back in with the same name and password.
reasons.insufficientBalance: Not enough balance. Top up credits and try again.
reasons.productNotFound: Item not found; the store may have changed.
reasons.inProgress: Your previous purchase is still in progress.
reasons.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
reasons.disabled: The store is closed right now.
reasons.unavailable: Couldn't reach the website. Try again shortly.
reasons.serverUnreachable: Couldn't reach the account server. The game server may be offline.
reasons.pluginOutdated: The server's CevherAuth plugin doesn't support the store yet; tell an admin.
reasons.serverError: The server returned an error. Please tell the admins.

CONFIG_INVALID.title: Couldn't read server configuration
CONFIG_INVALID.message: The launcher configuration file is missing or invalid. Please let the admins know.

LAUNCHER_OUTDATED.title: Launcher out of date
LAUNCHER_OUTDATED.message: This server requires Cevherclient {{required}} or newer (you have {{current}}).

UNKNOWN.title: Unexpected error
UNKNOWN.message: Something went wrong. If it keeps happening, restart the launcher.

update.readyMessage: Cevherclient {{version}} was downloaded. The launcher will restart to install it.

mods.fabricOn: Fabric on — mods will be loaded into the game.
mods.fabricOff: Fabric off — the game starts unmodded (vanilla); the Performance Pack and auto-close on leaving the server won't work.
mods.installedMessage: Mods will load the next time you press Play.

desc.fabric-api: Core library other mods depend on.
desc.sodium: Rewrites the rendering engine; the biggest FPS gain.
desc.lithium: Speeds up game logic and tick calculations.
desc.immediatelyfast: Speeds up UI and immediate-mode rendering.
desc.entityculling: Skips rendering entities you can't see.
desc.dynamic-fps: Lowers FPS while the window is in the background to save resources.
desc.iris: Loads shader packs into the game.
desc.modmenu: Lets you view and configure installed mods in-game.
desc.shulkerboxtooltip: Shows the contents of a shulker box when you hover over it.
desc.lambdynamiclights: Held items such as torches light up their surroundings dynamically.
desc.smoothplayeranimations: Makes player movement and animations fluid.
desc.appleskin: Shows the hunger and saturation values of food.
desc.xaeros-world-map: A full-screen world map that records where you have been.
desc.entitytexturefeatures: Adds support for random and emissive entity textures.

profile.passwordNote: Changing your password signs out your launcher on other computers.
profile.passwordChanged: You stay signed in on this computer.
profile.siteHint: Balance, credit top-ups, orders and e-mail are managed from your cevhercraft.com account.

modBrowser.title: Find Mods & Shaders
modBrowser.needsServer: Must also be on the server — may not work here
modBrowser.empty: No suitable mods found for this version.
modBrowser.fabricOff: Turn on Fabric above to install mods.
modBrowser.installedMessage: {{name}} will load the next time you press Play.
modBrowser.emptyShader: No suitable shaders found for this version.
modBrowser.shaderAutoIris: Installing a shader also installs the required Iris Shaders mod automatically.
modBrowser.shaderModFound: You already have a shader mod ({{name}}); Iris will not be installed.
modBrowser.shaderInstalledWithIris: {{name}} and {{loader}} will load the next time you press Play. Pick it in Options → Video Settings → Shader Packs.

quality.title: Choose your quality level
quality.subtitle: First launch of Cevherclient. Your choice decides which shader is installed; performance settings are optimized to the highest level in all three.
quality.note: You can change this at any time in the settings.
quality.wait: Downloading mod and shader files, this can take a few minutes…
quality.doneMessage: {{shader}} installed. It becomes active on the next Play.
quality.settingsHint: The options only change the shader; the optimization settings are the same, and at the highest level, for every tier.

high.name: High
high.desc: Every effect and the most advanced shader (Complementary Unbound). Recommended for a recent machine.

medium.name: Medium
medium.desc: A balance between looks and smoothness (Photon). The right pick for a mid-range machine.

low.name: Low
low.desc: As light as possible (SuperDuperVanilla). For older or entry-level machines.
